record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Ever felt confused because you couldn’t understand the language? With GoTranslator, you know exactly what’s being said — and how to reply. From asking directions to chatting with friends or reading signs, GoTranslator helps you understand the world instantly.

It’s more than a dictionary. GoTranslator turns your phone into a travel companion with real-time voice translation, offline packs, camera translation, and travel phrases. Communication has never been this effortless.

GOTRANSLATOR - MAIN FEATURES

Conversation Mode - Talk & Translate Instantly
- Speak freely and hear instant translations. Conversation Mode supports real-time two-way voice translation for natural dialogue without typing.

Camera Translate
- Point your camera at menus or signs for instant translation on your screen. Perfect for restaurants, shops, and transit stations.

Offline Translation
- No internet? No problem. Download languages in advance to translate anywhere, even in airplane mode.

Standard Text Translation
- Quickly translate words, sentences, or paragraphs in 100+ languages with ease. Get accurate results for messages, signs, or documents in seconds.

Typing Translator – Translate While You Type
- Type in your language and see instant translations appear in real time. The Keyboard Translator works across apps, helping you chat or write emails without switching applications.

OTHER IMPORTANT FEATURES

Travel Phrasebook
- Access ready-to-use phrases for travel situations: greetings, directions, emergencies, and dining. Speak like a local instantly.

Travel Utilities – Smart Tools
- More than translation. Handle everyday needs with: Currency Converter, Unit Converter, and Time Zone Converter.

Saved Translations
- Keep track of important translations. Save any phrase for quick access later — great for repeat-use or learning new expressions.

Light & Dark Mode
- Use the app day or night with your preferred appearance. Enjoy optimal readability and comfort wherever you go.

HOW TO USE GOTRANSLATOR

- Open the app and grant microphone and camera access.
- Select your source and target languages.
- Tap the microphone for real-time conversation translation.
- Use the camera icon for visual translation of printed text.
- Access offline mode and the phrasebook in settings.
- Save useful phrases to revisit anytime — even offline.

- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Canceled subscriptions remain active until the end of the period. No refunds for the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

record.description_evidence:
Chat now in any language without switching apps! TransKey translates your messages in real-time inside any app using the keyboard!

TransKey is the best chat translator trusted by over 300,000 users and featured on sites like CNET, Product Hunt, Addictive Tips, and more!

Over 10,000 5-star App Store reviews! 
"I didn't think something like this was possible, but I'm happy to say I've been proven wrong. This is a great app to have on your iPhone!"

―
WHAT IS IT
TransKey is a keyboard extension that translates your messages inside any app (like: WhatsApp, iMessage, Facebook, Twitter X, Email, Chat Apps, SMS, and many more).

TransKey also works the other way around. Copy the text you can't understand and TransKey will show you what it means in your native language!

―
HOW DOES IT WORK

Write what you'd like to say, but before sending your message, tap and hold the Globe key to switch to TransKey. After selecting a target language, tap "Translate text" and watch your message get translated right in the app! 

If you'd like to translate a message you received, tap and hold it until an option to "Copy" appears. In TransKey tap "Translate copy", and the translation will appear in the same place!

Never encounter another language barrier again when communicating with people in other countries! TransKey provides a flawless translation experience right in the messaging app of your choice unlike other translators which interrupt the flow by forcing you to switch to another app.

Unlike other translator keyboards, TransKey does not have a keyboard for typing. This allows you to use the keyboard you're most comfortable with, such as the iOS, GBoard, or SwiftKey.

―

How to use TransKey:
1. Type something
2. Switch to TransKey keyboard
3. Translate text
3. Tap to insert translated text 

Without TransKey:
1. Type your text
2. Copy the text
3. Switch to Google Translate
4. Paste your message
5. Translate the message
6. Copy the translated message
7. Exit the translation app
8. Return to your app
9. Paste the translated message

―
FEATURES
• Translate the last sentence of any text field directly within any app
• Translate received messages directly within any app
• Fast and accurate translation to and from over 100 languages
• Automatic detection of source language
• Copy the translation to be used anywhere
• Optimized for all iPhone screen sizes in both portrait and landscape
Preserves capitalization and emojis
Quick language switch, saves time

―
POPULAR LANGUAGES
Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese, German, Italian, Russian, Dutch, French, Korean, Ukrainian, Arabic, Burmese, Cantonese, Czech, Filipino, Greek, Hebrew, Romanian, Samoan, Swedish, Thai, Tongan, and more.  

Use Transkey in conjunction with languages learning apps like: Duolingo, Pimsleur, Babbel, HelloTalk, Drops, Busuu, and Rosetta Stone

―
NOTICES
For accurate real-time translations, TransKey relies on industry leading machine-translation engines such as Google Translate, Microsoft Translate, and Yandex Translate. AI translators are not used in this version.

You will need to grant Transkey full access for it to work properly. They keyboard will need to get the text you type so it can send it to the translation service. We do not store anything you translate. See the Privacy Policy.

Terms and Conditions: https://transkey.io/terms.pdf
Privacy Policy: https://transkey.io/privacy.pdf

PAYMENT AND AUTOMATIC RENEWAL TERMS:
When first installed TransKey is in trial mode where you get 10 translations per day. For less than 50 cents per day you can upgrade to TransKey Premium, with unlimited high-quality translations. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your Apple ID account and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You will not be able to cancel a subscription during the active period. You can manage your subscriptions in your Account Settings after purchase.

―
SUPPORT
Contact us by email at hello@transkey.io.

record.name: Babel Browser
record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The Babel Browser comes built-in with "Immersive Translate" eliminating the need for additional extensions to enjoy the convenience of one-click bilingual reading, bilingual video subtitles, PDF translations, and more.

"Immersive Translate" is a free, useful, highly acclaimed, AI-driven bilingual web page translation extension designed to effectively bridge the information gap.

Key Features:

Immersive Reading of Foreign Websites: By intelligently identifying and translating the main content area of web pages into a bilingual comparison, Immersive Translate offers a novel reading experience in foreign languages, hence the name "Immersive Translate."

Immersive Video Browsing: Powered by AI, it supports bilingual subtitle translation for dozens of mainstream video sites including YouTube, Netflix, Coursera, and more.

Powerful Input Box Translation: Transforms any webpage's input box into a multilingual translator, instantly unlocking a bilingual real-time conversation experience with tools like Google Search.

Efficient Document Translation: One-click export of bilingual eBooks, along with real-time bilingual translation support for PDFs, subtitles, TXT files, and more.

Innovative Mouse Hover Translation: Simply hover the mouse over any paragraph on any webpage, and the translation will immediately appear below the paragraph. Paragraphs are considered the smallest unit in the design philosophy of Immersive Translate, preserving their context so we can truly understand and learn foreign languages.

Deep Customization and Optimization for Mainstream Websites: Optimized for Google, Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, and other mainstream sites, ensuring smoother and more efficient searching, socializing, and information gathering.

Full Platform Support: Besides all major desktop browsers, mobile devices also offer the same immersive translation experience, making bilingual browsing of social media like Twitter and Reddit easy.

Support for 10+ Translation Services: Within Immersive Translate, you can choose from over 10 translation services such as Deepl, Microsoft Translate, Google Translate, Tencent Translate, and more, with the list continuously expanding.

"Immersive Translate" is free to use, hoping everyone can effortlessly, pleasantly, and elegantly access the wealth of foreign language information on the internet without language barriers.

record.name: Mindtrip: AI Travel Companion
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Whether you’re navigating a buzzing city or escaping to somewhere serene, Mindtrip is always in your pocket — ready to help you do it better (and yes, it’s totally free).

Get smart suggestions on what to see and do, and where to stay and eat — tailored to your vibe and location. Map your route, check what’s nearby and easily add stops to your trip plan.

Ask anything along the way and get instant AI-powered answers — plus trusted tips from real travelers and local experts. Need to shift gears? Update your plans on the fly. Traveling with others? Invite them to join your trip and make memories together, stress free.

Mindtrip puts everything you need for smart, seamless travel at your fingertips — personalized, organized and always a step ahead. You explore. We’ll handle the rest.


What’s in the App

• Personalized Recommendations: Get tailored suggestions for where to stay, eat and explore based on your travel vibe.

• Chat: Ask anything and get instant, AI-powered answers. Dig deeper and tweak your plans as you go.

• Interactive Maps: See what’s nearby, check distances and get smart routes wherever you are.

• Events: Discover what’s happening near you, from major concerts and sports to local happenings.

• Guides: Explore tips and itineraries created by real locals and travel experts who know a place inside out.

• Magic Camera: Snap a photo to learn more about what you’re seeing or instantly translate signs, menus and labels.

• Start Anywhere: Turn travel inspo from articles, videos, photos or Google Maps, into a chat, collection or trip plan.

• Collections: Save inspiration and favorites by theme or destination to revisit anytime or share with friends.

• Collaboration Tools: Invite friends into group chats. Share collections and itineraries you can edit together.

• Trips: Keep everything for a destination in one flexible hub — key details, chats, media, ideas, itineraries and bookings.

Mindtrip helps you travel differently — with everything you need, right when you need it.


We Love Feedback
We’re on a mission to make Mindtrip your ultimate travel companion — and your feedback helps shape what comes next. Got a feature idea, something you’re loving or something that could be better? Drop us a line at hello@mindtrip.ai and help make the app (and your next adventure) even better.

- Get directions on your favorite application (Google map, Apple map, Waze)

- We have tailor-made inventories to meet your needs and budget, from a large suitcase for long trips with family to a carry-on back bag for short solo trips.

- Access your trip plans offline
- Suggest the best restaurant along the way

****You are in control**** 

Move, modify, or remove anything you want. the more you use iplan.ai the more we understand your tastes and create a more efficient itinerary for you 
Install the application today and enjoy your trip
